points.description: Names method of moments as one of the two methods (any wording, e.g. moments matching).
Names method of maximum likelihood as the other method (e.g. maximum likelihood estimation, MLE).

rubric.notes: Award 1 mark for each of the two methods named: method of moments and maximum likelihood. Informal wording or abbreviations like MLE are accepted. Extra wrong remarks do not cost marks unless they replace a correct method; 0 for answers naming neither.
